description: Write comprehensive Vitest unit tests for the API routes, mocking DB repositories and verifying the route handlers behave correctly
steps: Create lib/__tests__/api-routes-npcs.test.ts testing NPC routes: test GET /api/npcs returns paginated list, test GET /api/npcs?zoneId=xxx uses getNPCsByZone, test POST /api/npcs calls createNPC and createAuditLog, test GET /api/npcs/[id] returns single NPC, test GET /api/npcs/[id] returns 404 for missing NPC, test PUT /api/npcs/[id] calls updateNPC/audit/invalidate, test DELETE /api/npcs/[id] calls deleteNPC/audit/invalidate.

Create lib/__tests__/api-routes-zones.test.ts testing Zone routes: test GET /api/zones returns paginated list, test GET /api/zones?type=city filters by type, test POST /api/zones calls createZone with validation, test GET /api/zones/[id] returns 404 for missing, test PUT/DELETE work correctly with audit and cache.

Create lib/__tests__/api-routes-search.test.ts testing search endpoint: test GET /api/search?q=warrior&type=npc calls searchNPCs, test missing q parameter returns error, test pagination limit parameter works.

Mock strategy: vi.mock the repository modules (lib/db/repositories/*), vi.mock lib/db/audit.ts, vi.mock lib/cache/patterns.ts, vi.mock lib/auth/session.ts (return dev user for getUserFromRequest). Create NextRequest objects using new NextRequest(url) with appropriate headers. Call the exported route handlers directly.
Ensure all tests pass with: bun run test:run
acceptance_criteria: At least 3 test files exist covering NPCs, Zones, and Search routes
Tests mock all external dependencies (DB repos, audit, cache, auth)
Tests verify correct repository function is called with correct arguments
Tests verify audit logging is called after mutations
Tests verify cache invalidation is called after mutations
Tests verify 404 responses for missing entities
All tests pass with bun run test:run
